question: Which among the following is India's first Human spaceflight programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gaganyaan.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mission Gaganyaan has been dubbed as 'India's maiden human spaceflight program'.
 
• India is planning to send the astronauts into space.
 
• Under the Gaganyaan schedule, three flights will be sent in orbit.
 
• Of the three, there will be two unmanned flights and one human spaceflight.
 
• The human space flight program, called the Orbital Module will have three Indian astronauts, including a woman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Aditya L-I
 It is a solar coronagraph mission of ISRO.
